svg.title: Running White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. White loop and lower continuation traced by eye; Bézier curvature approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.moma.org/collection/works/78403; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
